Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly claimed that “Oedipus at Colonus” corresponds to the Greek title “Oedipus Tyrannus,” conflating two different Sophoclean plays. Oedipus Tyrannus is the Greek title of Oedipus Rex (Oedipus the King), not Oedipus at Colonus. This unverified “standardization” led toward an incorrect sentence completion.
